versions.changelog:
luo-shen-fu 1.0.0

- Initial release of luoshenfu-literary-research skill.
- Enables comprehensive analysis of 《洛神赋》, including literary significance, cultural context, historical influences, philosophical (Chan Buddhism) dimensions, and feminine imagery.
- Supports detailed research articles in Simplified Chinese (approx. 3000–8000 characters) with scholarly citations and textual annotations.
- Special focus on parallels with 《红楼梦》 and Zhi Yanzhai commentary, including analytical frameworks to compare characters such as Miaoyu and Lin Daiyu.
- Guarantees academic rigor, source cross-checks, and contextualized discussion of classical and modern interpretations.
